assets.prompt: Create a transparent-background high-detail dark-fantasy PIXEL ART game sprite sheet, EXACTLY THREE equally sized square cells in ONE horizontal row, no text, no scenery, no ground discs. Same single tiny feline humanoid fey in every cell: an Ovinnik depicted provisionally for a Pathfinder campaign, a small wiry soot-black catlike creature standing on hind legs, tufted ears, long tail, sharp claws, amber eyes. Three subtle combat-ready idle frames: weight left, centered poised, weight right and tail shifted. Faces toward lower-left (enemy at upper-right facing our party), three-quarter front view. Full body fits well inside each cell with generous transparent margins, feet aligned on same baseline, no artwork crossing cells. Detailed crisp pixel clusters like a gothic 32-bit RPG, muted charcoal fur, restrained warm eye highlights, readable at 65 pixels tall. Creature should be clearly small feline fey, not a hulking werewolf. This is a new visual interpretation; no claim of canonical portrait. Output wide 3:1 sprite sheet with preserved alpha.

Transparent dark-fantasy high-detail PIXEL ART game sprite sheet. EXACT equal grid THREE columns FOUR rows, twelve individual full-body sprites. Same scale and baseline within each row, generous padding, no body or weapon crosses a cell boundary. Each character clear at 55-75 pixels tall. No text, labels, scenery, ground circles or colored background. Row 1: Bo Gramel, an elderly retired Chelish artillerywoman with gray hair and practical dark burgundy civilian clothes; three facings front, left three-quarter, right three-quarter, holding a small cooking pan. Row 2: Dent Gramel, elderly retired artilleryman with gray hair, simple olive/brown civilian clothes, front and two three-quarter facings, hands resting at his belt. These appearances are provisional adaptations, no invented military insignia. Row 3: Riley Kels disguised as the Angel Knight: young adult human bard, silver-looking armor and distinctive closed wing-like silver helm over concealed leather, no visible face, NOT a real angel, no wings. Three front three-quarter combat idle frames, faces toward lower-left, holds a simple sword ready and shifts weight subtly. Row 4: three completely anonymous masked rescuers, two adult human silhouettes and one short halfling silhouette, muted dark travel clothes and cloth face coverings. Stand facing front three-quarter, no insignia, no unique named identities, no gore. Art matches a gothic detailed 32-bit fantasy sprite game: crisp pixel clusters, warm muted palette, sharp readable outlines, transparent alpha throughout. All feet and heads fully visible. Output a regular 3x4 atlas.

Edit this existing high-detail dark fantasy pixel-art town square map for a new story phase. Preserve the church facade, side buildings, entrances, paved walking routes, scale, viewpoint, dimensions, pixel-art aesthetic, and TRANSPARENT OUTER BORDER. Add a modest raised dark wooden execution platform in the central paved square, approximately normalized x 0.38..0.62, y 0.43..0.60, with a simple wooden guillotine standing toward its rear and small steps leading down toward the viewer. No people, no text, no blood or severed bodies. The guillotine is a recognizable restrained medieval wood prop. Keep ample traversable pavement to left, right and below the platform. Replace the central decorative compass only where covered by the platform; everything else remains coherent with the original map. Subtle dusk warm lantern lighting matching the same scene. New version should be a reusable foreground map over a separate background layer, transparent beyond map borders, no sky or ocean baked in.
